6. Tools (13). 9-row table, one line each, no byte claims. Link docs/tools.md.
7. Commands (7). /ctx-stats, /ctx-doctor, /ctx-upgrade; on Claude Code also /context-mode:ctx-* (TECH-SPEC:209 live probe). Others: ask the model to run the tool.
8. How it works (12). 4 hook events + MCP server; one DB per project at `~/.context-mode/projects/<hash>/context.db` (ADR-0002:17); search scope default only after Q6; enforcement one line only after ADR-0008 is Accepted and squared with the owner's hard-deny decision (R15). Hookless agents: tools and search only (D18).
9. Benchmarks (10). Only if re-measured on v2 with date + agent version. If not measured at release: omit the section. No placeholder.
10. Privacy and security (8). No telemetry, no LLM/API calls (D15). Network: update check (`git ls-remote`) and the agent's own git fetch. Drop the permission-rules line until v2 specs it (R20).
11. Documentation (14). Bullet list of docs/ files.
12. Support (5). "Issues, discussions and outside pull requests are closed." Help = docs/troubleshooting.md + `/ctx-doctor` output; Discord only if the owner keeps it (it is the only channel left, R11).
13. License (3). ELv2, one sentence, link LICENSE.

design:
GOAL: per release the owner does 2 acts: (1) run the live harness, which ends with one signed tag push; (2) one 'release' approval click. Everything else is machine-run. Fixes vs prior design: no workflow_run (F19), no '--unreleased' (F12), no 'npx claude' (F5), no close-PR workflow (F15), no Dependabot (F16), git-native signed tag instead of an orphan 'attest' branch (F14).

A. WHERE FILES LIVE (F19, F20). Default branch stays main.
- On v2: ci.yml (on: push to v2 and any branch; workflow_call) and release.yml (on: push tags 'e2e-pass/*', workflow_dispatch). Tag push triggers work from any branch (events:790).
- On main (needs one owner-approved commit; package.json untouched, so v1 /ctx-upgrade still no-ops): traffic.yml (cron '0 3 * * 1'), weekly.yml (cron: smoke-install from @release + repo-settings drift + 'npm audit' on a v2 checkout). Remove from main at the same commit: bundle.yml, update-stats.yml, openclaw-e2e.yml, tier2-e2e-smoke.yml. Keep main ci.yml only if v1 still needs it; otherwise delete.
- No pull_request_target, no Dependabot: PRs are off (F15).

B. VERSION + NOTES: scripts/release/plan.mjs (no deps).
1. git fetch origin release v2 --tags. No 'release' branch → version 2.0.0, range = (none, hand-written notes for 2.0.0).
2. Else version = release:.claude-plugin/plugin.json; src = trailer 'Source-Commit:' of release HEAD.
3. Commits src..SHA: '!:' or 'BREAKING CHANGE' → major; feat → minor; fix|perf → patch; else exit 'no release' (job green, tag left for audit).
4. Notes: 'git cliff src..SHA --tag v$V -o notes.md' (F12). Release tags use 'v2.*' so doctor can filter out v1 tags (v1.0.169 etc. exist): doctor/upgrade must use 'git ls-remote --tags origin "v2.*"' and take the highest semver.

C. LIVE GATE, NO KEYS (F14, F17). e2e/live/run.mjs on the owner's Mac, inside logged-in Claude Code ('claude -p', plus codex/others if logged in). On pass it runs: git -c gpg.format=ssh -c user.signingkey=~/.ssh/cm_e2e.pub tag -s e2e-pass/<sha12> <v2-sha> -m '<json: harnessVersion, agentVersions, cases, pass:true>' && git push origin e2e-pass/<sha12>. The owner's push starts release.yml (F10: user pushes trigger, GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not). CI job live-gate: git -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile=.github/allowed_signers verify-tag e2e-pass/<sha12>; check the tag's target == the commit being released and json.pass == true. The tag object pins the SHA, so no 'sha' field can lie. No secret in CI. One path: release.yml has no other release trigger (workflow_dispatch only for rollback mode).

D. release.yml (on v2):
on: push: tags ['e2e-pass/*']; workflow_dispatch: inputs {mode: rollback, to: v2.x.y}
permissions: contents: read
jobs:
  live-gate: verify-tag (C); output sha.
  ci: needs live-gate; uses ./.github/workflows/ci.yml with ref=sha (GP1-GP11, 3 OS, node:test, GS5 names, manifest drift).
  plan: needs live-gate; plan.mjs + git-cliff range; outputs version, release.
  build: needs plan, if release; npm ci; scripts/release/build.mjs --version V --out dist/release (bundles, every manifest generated from adapters/table.ts, 3 skills, no package.json); check-tree.mjs (no package.json, GS5 names absent, manifests == generator); npx -y @anthropic-ai/claude-code@<pin> plugin validate dist/release (F5, F6); sorted SHA256SUMS; actions/attest-build-provenance on SHA256SUMS (id-token: write, attestations: write); upload.
  publish: needs [ci, build]; environment: release (required reviewer = owner, self-review prevention OFF, deployment rule: tag 'e2e-pass/*'); job-level concurrency {group: publish, cancel-in-progress: false} so a half-done push is never cancelled; permissions contents: write. Steps: fetch release or 'git switch --orphan release'; replace tree; commit 'release v$V' + trailer 'Source-Commit: $SHA'; tag v$V; git push origin release v$V; gh release create v$V --target release --notes-file notes.md --latest SHA256SUMS release.tgz.
  smoke: needs publish; matrix ubuntu/macos/windows; clean HOME/CODEX_HOME; claude: npx -y @anthropic-ai/claude-code@<pin> plugin marketplace add <local checkout of release> before step b, mksglu/context-mode after; plugin install; codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode@release + plugin add, assert cache dir == V (F7); gemini install only after F8 is tested. Assert installed tree hash == SHA256SUMS. If smoke fails: job red, owner runs rollback.
Workflow-level concurrency: {group: release, cancel-in-progress: true} only cancels runs still waiting before publish.
Rollback (same file, mode=rollback, env release): new release commit with the old tree and a HIGHER patch (F7, ADR-0011:13). Never force-push.
G22 mapping: step a = 'release' click (merges a + c: the GitHub Release is the release note). Step b (marketplace ref on main) = one-time job 'switch-main' in release.yml mode=switch, env release, edits only .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugins[0] (ref release, no version), runs plugin validate, clean-HOME install, direct push to main (no PRs exist). If the owner wants docs on main updated per release, add a job 'docs' with its own env 'announce' and a direct push; default is: README links to the latest GitHub Release, so no per-release main edit.

E. RULESETS (F22): on 'release' and tags 'v2.*' and 'e2e-pass/*': block force push, restrict deletion. Do not use 'Restrict updates' unless a GitHub App token is added. Settings drift is checked weekly by weekly.yml with read-only GITHUB_TOKEN (environments, rulesets, has_pull_requests=false, has_issues=false) against .github/settings.json.

F. SECURITY (F18): secret scanning + push protection already on. Turn on CodeQL default setup (actions + javascript-typescript). Pin every action by SHA. ci.yml permissions: contents: read.

G. DELETE: bundle.yml, update-stats.yml, openclaw-e2e.yml, tier2-e2e-smoke.yml (from main), scripts/version-sync.mjs, scripts/assert-asymmetric-drift.mjs (check its v2 need), .claude/skills/context-mode-ops/, stats.json (badges → metrics/traffic.json). Rewrite TECH-SPEC 6.9, :279 and Q8 :413 to the local harness + signed tag (F4).

H. NEVER AUTOMATABLE: npm OTP; live model runs (no keys); VS Code Copilot live (TECH-SPEC:368); the G22 click; PAT TRAFFIC_TOKEN renewal; the SSH signing key stays on the Mac.

doctor/upgrade must read only 'v2.*' tags (v1 tags exist). Confirm, or read plugin.json version at release HEAD instead (one ls-remote vs one raw fetch).
Can the GITHUB_TOKEN actor be a ruleset bypass actor on github.com? If not, keep only no-force-push/no-delete on 'release' (F22).
